# DS064

**DS064** is a specific medical diagnosis code representing traumatic epidural hemorrhage (*traumatisk epidural blødning*). In the context of the Danish healthcare system, it serves as a critical data point for tracking severe bleeding complications among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1]. 

The code is systematically utilized by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to evaluate the safety of anticoagulation therapies. Specifically, DS064 is one of the primary identifiers used to measure the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] (intracranial hemorrhage) in both incident and prevalent atrial fibrillation patient populations [^src1] [^src3]. It functions alongside a narrow set of related intracranial codes, namely [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds065|DS065]], and [[ds066|DS066]], to capture these specific neurological bleeding events [^src1]. 

Beyond intracranial events, DS064 is also embedded within a much broader diagnostic framework used to calculate the overall incidence of severe bleeding. In this wider context, it is grouped with codes for gastrointestinal bleeding (such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) as well as urinary and respiratory tract bleeding (including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. By standardizing the application of DS064 and its associated codes, RKKP ensures precise, comparable data collection across Danish regions, which is essential for assessing the risk profiles of treatments like DOACs versus Marevan [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].
